title: Fix StructuredFormats.plan strict schema (steps: string[]) contradicting PlanManager typed object step contract

sections.what: Update StructuredFormats.plan in static/js/shared/json-schemas.ts (left on strict string[] when task-700 migrated plan-manager.ts to typed step objects) so strict JSON-schema providers expect the exact {act, item, target, text, note, area, until, duration} step objects requested by the prompt.
sections.why: StructuredFormats.plan (static/js/shared/json-schemas.ts lines 137-148) sets strict: true with steps: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, while task-700 changed static/js/agent/plan-manager.ts (lines 279, 292) to require {"steps": [{"act": ...}]} and line 310 still sends _structuredFormats()?.plan (with line 203 JSDoc still saying Promise<string[]>). On strict-schema providers this forces string[] output that directly violates the planning prompt.
sections.how:
1. Update StructuredFormats.plan in static/js/shared/json-schemas.ts (lines 137-148) so steps.items defines the strict JSON object schema for typed plan steps ({act, item, target, text, note, area, until, duration} compatible with strict mode nullable/required constraints).
2. Update PlanManager return annotation (line 203 JSDoc currently reads Promise<string[]>) and strict-response handling in static/js/agent/plan-manager.ts while keeping graceful fallback for legacy string plans.
3. Rebuild TypeScript bundles (npm run build:ts) and run JS unit tests covering StructuredFormats.plan and PlanManager/PlanGrounding.
sections.verify:
1. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs covering StructuredFormats.plan schema definition and PlanManager plus PlanGrounding parsing.
2. Verify providers enforcing response_format receive typed step object schemas matching plan-manager.ts lines 279 and 292.

acceptance.text: StructuredFormats.plan strict schema requires steps elements matching the typed step object contract ({act, item, target, text, note, area, until, duration}) consumed by PlanManager and PlanGrounding, removing the string[] vs object conflict left behind by task-700.
PlanManager JSDoc and parsing helpers in static/js/agent/plan-manager.ts stay consistent with the typed object contract while keeping documented fallback support for non-strict providers.
Unit tests verify both strict StructuredFormats.plan schema validation and PlanManager/PlanGrounding step parsing end-to-end.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Planner Prompt Preview and Raw LLM Capture inspector when structured JSON outputs are enabled.

Current availability: task-700 migrated PlanManager prompts to typed step objects, while StructuredFormats.plan in static/js/shared/json-schemas.ts still defines steps as strict string[].

Manual verification steps:
1. Enable strict structured outputs on an LLM provider that enforces response_format JSON schema, then run an NPC planning turn.
2. Inspect Raw LLM Capture payload and parsed PlanManager steps.
   - expected: response_format.schema specifies typed step objects matching the prompt template, and returned steps parse cleanly into PlanGrounding.
